question: To whom may this Kaula teaching be transmitted and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy.
It should not be given indiscriminately.
Transmission to just anyone is prohibited.
inference: This Kaula teaching must be given only to the worthy and never to just anyone.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy, not given to just anyone.
